meta.title: Aurendel
meta.author: DungeonMaster
meta.description: A continent, and nothing else. Twelve regions from the Frostmere ice to the Glasslands, four cities, twelve towns, twenty villages, and the roads between them — with every shop, house, shrine, barrow, cave and castle you can walk into. No quests, no people, no loot: the geography is the whole of it, waiting for somebody to put a story in. Built on the Core Fantasy ruleset.

attributes.name: Might
attributes.description: Raw physical force: what you can lift, break, and hit with.

attributes.name: Agility
attributes.description: Speed, balance, and hands that do what you tell them.

attributes.name: Endurance
attributes.description: How much the world can take out of you before you stop.

attributes.name: Intellect
attributes.description: Learning, reasoning, and the memory to hold a long thought.

attributes.name: Instinct
attributes.description: What you notice without being told, and what you feel about it.

attributes.name: Presence
attributes.description: The weight you carry in a room, and your grip on your own nerve.

resources.name: Hit Points
resources.description: What is left between you and the end of the story.

resources.name: Focus
resources.description: Concentration spent on the difficult thing rather than the ordinary one.

derivedStats.name: Guard
derivedStats.description: How hard you are to land a blow on.

derivedStats.name: Initiative
derivedStats.description: Who moves first when it starts.

derivedStats.name: Carry
derivedStats.description: What you can haul before it starts to matter.

damageTypes.name: Cold
damageTypes.description: The heat taken out of a thing.

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.description: An open wound that has not been seen to.

conditions.name: Burning
conditions.description: Alight, and not going out on its own.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: Something in the blood that should not be there.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.description: Nerve gone, and the body arguing for the door.

conditions.name: Emboldened
conditions.description: Steadied, and standing a little straighter for it.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: Sight gone, whether from dark, dazzle, or injury.

conditions.name: Slowed
conditions.description: Every movement costs more than it should.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: Nothing gets through for a moment.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: On the ground, and everyone above you knows it.

savingThrows.name: Fortitude
savingThrows.description: Enduring what the body must endure.

savingThrows.name: Reflex
savingThrows.description: Being somewhere else when it lands.

savingThrows.name: Will
savingThrows.description: Holding your own mind against something that wants it.

actionTypes.name: Action
actionTypes.description: The one substantial thing you do in a turn.

actionTypes.name: Quick Action
actionTypes.description: Something done in the same breath as the main thing.

actionTypes.name: Reaction
actionTypes.description: Spent out of turn, on somebody else's mistake.

actionTypes.name: Speech
actionTypes.description: Talking costs nothing but the breath.

actionTypes.name: Gesture
actionTypes.description: A sign, a point, a hand held up.

itemProperties.name: Silvered
itemProperties.description: Chased with silver along the edge. Old things feel it.

itemProperties.name: Two-Handed
itemProperties.description: Needs both hands, and gives up the shield to get them.

itemProperties.name: Finesse
itemProperties.description: Rewards a quick hand over a heavy one.

itemProperties.name: Thrown
itemProperties.description: Meant to leave your hand and be regretted at a distance.

itemProperties.name: Heavy
itemProperties.description: Slow to bring round, and worth it when it lands.

itemProperties.name: Reach
itemProperties.description: Keeps them a step further away than they would like.

creatureTypes.name: Beast
creatureTypes.description: Things that hunt because they are hungry.

creatureTypes.name: Construct
creatureTypes.description: Made things that were given a purpose and kept it.

creatureTypes.name: Elemental
creatureTypes.description: Fire, stone, storm, and flood, given a shape and a temper.

creatureTypes.name: Fey
creatureTypes.description: Old, courteous, and not remotely safe.

creatureTypes.name: Giant
creatureTypes.description: Large enough that the ground remembers them.

creatureTypes.name: Dragon
creatureTypes.description: Winged, scaled, and older than the roads.

creatureTypes.name: Aberration
creatureTypes.description: Shapes that do not belong to this world's grammar.

creatureTypes.name: Plant
creatureTypes.description: What grows, and sometimes reaches back.

languages.name: Common
languages.description: The trade tongue of the roads and the ports.

languages.name: The Old Tongue
languages.description: What was written before the roads were cut.

languages.name: Delving Cant
languages.description: The clipped speech of the deep holds, half of it struck on stone.

languages.name: Sylvan
languages.description: The forest speech. Nobody agrees on how many words it has.

languages.name: Steppe Tongue
languages.description: Carried by riders, and by nobody who stays put.

languages.name: Glass Script
languages.description: A southern script, cut rather than written.

rests.name: Breather
rests.description: An hour sat down, out of the wind.

rests.name: Make Camp
rests.description: A fire, a watch rota, and eight hours of not walking.

rests.name: Take a Room
rests.description: A bed with a roof over it. Nothing interrupts a paid bed.

senses.name: Sight
senses.description: What you can see, which is nothing at all through a wall. Either something is in view or it is not, so every threshold is the same.

senses.name: Hearing
senses.description: Sound travels in a straight line and stops at stone, but passes an open doorway perfectly well. It fades with distance, so a far-off clatter is worth walking towards and a near one is worth drawing steel for.

senses.name: Smell
senses.description: Scent seeps around corners and hangs about long after you have gone. A hound follows where you went rather than where you are, and a cold trail is faint even underfoot.

stances.name: Sneak
stances.description: Slow and careful. Half pace, a fifth the noise, and rather less of your smell on the wind.

stances.name: Walk
stances.description: An ordinary pace. Nothing gained, nothing given away.

stances.name: Dash
stances.description: Quick, and heard from a long way off.

opportunities.name: Parting Blow
opportunities.description: Anyone who walks out of your reach gives you one free swing, which is what makes disengaging a decision rather than a formality.

skills.name: Athletics
skills.description: Climbing, swimming, forcing, and holding on.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: Moving without being heard. Ranks quieten a careful step further; nothing makes you silent outright.

skills.name: Lockpicking
skills.description: Locks, latches, and the small mechanisms of other people's privacy.

skills.name: Craft
skills.description: Joining, shaping, and repairing with the right tool in hand.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Tracks, weather, water, and which way is out.

skills.name: Perception
skills.description: Noticing the thing that was not meant to be noticed.

skills.name: Insight
skills.description: Reading a face for what it is not saying.

skills.name: Medicine
skills.description: Wounds, fevers, and knowing when to stop trying.

skills.name: Lore
skills.description: History, heraldry, and what the old books actually said.

skills.name: Arcana
skills.description: Wards, runes, and the shape of a working.

skills.name: Nature
skills.description: Beasts, growing things, and the habits of both.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.description: Getting a yes out of someone who began with no.

skills.name: Resolve
skills.description: Holding your nerve when the situation stops being reasonable.

abilities.name: Strike
abilities.description: A swing with whatever you are holding.

abilities.name: Quick Shot
abilities.description: A shot loosed before the target has finished deciding.

abilities.name: Guarded Stance
abilities.description: Give up the initiative and keep the ribs.

abilities.name: Rally
abilities.description: A word at the right moment, worth more than a shield.

abilities.name: Shove
abilities.description: Put them on the ground and take the second you bought.

abilities.name: First Aid
abilities.description: Pressure, a clean strip of cloth, and a hand that does not shake.

abilities.name: Read Runes
abilities.description: An hour with a hand on the carving, and it gives up its sense.

abilities.name: Wardlight
abilities.description: A cold light that clings to the one who holds it.

abilities.name: Arcane Bolt
abilities.description: A splinter of will, thrown.

abilities.name: Frost Lance
abilities.description: A line of cold, drawn straight through whatever is standing in it.

abilities.name: Mend Flesh
abilities.description: The wound closes, though it will still want telling about later.

abilities.name: Turn the Dark
abilities.description: Named aloud, the old cold gives ground.

abilities.name: Augury
abilities.description: An hour of quiet and the right question, and something answers.

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.description: Teeth, and a great deal of enthusiasm.

abilities.name: Gore
abilities.description: Head down, and it does not stop when it connects.

abilities.name: Grave Chill
abilities.description: The cold of a sealed place, reaching.

abilities.name: Wither
abilities.description: What the barrows do to a living hand.

abilities.name: Stone Fist
abilities.description: Slow, and it does not need to be fast.

abilities.name: Spore Burst
abilities.description: A cloud, and then a great deal of coughing.

abilities.name: Cinder Lash
abilities.description: Something between a limb and a flow.

abilities.name: Glass Shard
abilities.description: Thrown, and it does not lose its edge on the way.

abilities.name: Rime Touch
abilities.description: Everything it holds stops moving quite so freely.

abilities.name: Latch On
abilities.description: It does not bite so much as attach, and then not let go.

abilities.name: Drag Under
abilities.description: A hand at the ankle, and the water is closer than it was.

abilities.name: Cudgel
abilities.description: A length of ash with a nail through it, swung by somebody who has done this before.

abilities.name: Cut and Run
abilities.description: A short blade, low, and then twenty yards of shingle.

abilities.name: Digging Claw
abilities.description: Made for spoil, and it does not know the difference.

abilities.name: Bleed White
abilities.description: Nothing you can feel happening, which is the trouble with it.

abilities.name: Toll
abilities.description: One note, under the water, and it is in your chest before it is in your ears.

abilities.name: Root and Branch
abilities.description: The beech has been growing round the hollow for four hundred years and has opinions about being disturbed.

abilities.name: Scouring Wind
abilities.description: Grit off two hundred miles of open grass, at the speed the grass grew used to.

abilities.name: Calving
abilities.description: A face of ice the height of a hall deciding, all at once, to be somewhere else.

abilities.name: Salt Burn
abilities.description: Nine hundred years of pan salt, and it takes the water out of whatever it is on.

abilities.name: Vent Breath
abilities.description: What the throat has been doing quietly for nine hundred years, done all at once and at you.

abilities.name: The Unmaking Word
abilities.description: Not shouted. Said, once, in a language the wards were written to refuse.

abilities.name: Call the Shut
abilities.description: It does not fight alone if it can help it.

ancestries.name: Human
ancestries.description: Everywhere, adaptable, and short-lived enough to be in a hurry about it.

ancestries.name: Dwarf
ancestries.description: Hold-born. They measure a thing in centuries and are rarely wrong about stone.

ancestries.name: Elf
ancestries.description: Wood-kin and ruin-keepers. Long memories, longer grudges.

ancestries.name: Halfling
ancestries.description: Small, unhurried, and very hard to catch.

ancestries.name: Orc
ancestries.description: Steppe-bred and hold-broken both. Reputation runs ahead of them and is usually wrong.

classes.name: Warden
classes.description: Trained to hold a line, a bridge, or a doorway, and to be the last one through it.

classes.name: Stalker
classes.description: Roads, roofs, and other people's locks. Prefers the fight that never starts.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: Between the settlements, where the roads stop being roads.

classes.name: Adept
classes.description: A scholar of workings. Fewer bones than the others and rather more books.

classes.name: Keeper
classes.description: Tends the shrines on the road and what walks between them.

items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: Plain, well balanced, and made by somebody who makes a great many.

items.name: Hunting Bow
items.description: Yew, drawn to the ear, and quiet.

items.name: Boar Spear
items.description: A crossbar below the head, so what you stop stays stopped.

items.name: Oak Staff
items.description: Shoulder height, iron-shod, and a great deal older than its owner.

items.name: Iron Mace
items.description: Flanged, short, and entirely honest about what it is for.

items.name: The Silvered Blade
items.description: Chased with silver along the edge. Old things feel it, and the wards were built against old things.

items.name: A Warden's Blade
items.description: One of nine, made when the wards were made, and this is the only one anybody has found.

items.name: Leather Jerkin
items.description: Boiled, shaped, and cheaper than caring about it.

items.name: Ring Mail
items.description: Rings sewn to a coat. Noisy, heavy, and it works.

items.name: The Warded Coat
items.description: Stitched through with fine wire in a pattern somebody copied off a standing stone without asking what it meant.

items.name: Bandages
items.description: Clean linen and a firm hand.

items.name: Healing Draught
items.description: Bitter, warm going down, and worth every mark.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: For the fen, the leech channels, and whatever the barrows use.

items.name: Ward Salt
items.description: A handful thrown over a threshold. The Keepers make it and will not say how.

items.name: The Undercroft Key
items.description: Iron, cold, and it carries the steward's seal on a cord.

items.name: The Wardlist
items.description: Nine entries in a hand four centuries dead. Three of them have been crossed through, recently, in different ink.

items.name: The Grown Key
items.description: Not carved. The Witchwood put out a shape and somebody took it.

items.name: The Cast Key
items.description: Poured, like the cathedral above it, in one piece and while hot.

items.name: The Glass Key
items.description: Fulgurite, hollow, and it rings a note that is very slightly wrong.

items.name: A Deep Warrant
items.description: Karn Dolur's seal on slate, and the ledger number that goes with it.

items.name: A Barrow Torc
items.description: Twisted gold, sized for a neck rather thicker than yours.

items.name: Hold Silver
items.description: Struck at Karn Dolur and stamped with a year nobody uses.

items.name: A Glass Bead
items.description: Crater glass, drilled, and green all the way through.

items.name: An Old Coin
items.description: Worn past reading on one face and perfectly sharp on the other.

items.name: Amber
items.description: Something is in it. Nobody agrees what.

items.name: Grave Ash
items.description: What a barrow-thing leaves. The Library buys it and will not say why.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: Graded and stamped at the Ore Yard.

items.name: Lantern Cap
items.description: Glows enough to read by for about nine hours.

items.name: Eel Skin
items.description: Cured, it will outlast the boot it is sewn to.

items.name: Wreck Brass
items.description: Fittings off something that did not make the passage. The Countinghouse would rather you did not say where.

items.name: A Poacher's Lamp
items.description: Shuttered on three sides, and the fourth is shuttered too until you want it. The eel-men make them and do not sell them.

items.name: The Tallow Hood
items.description: Waxed against the drip, black against the dark, and cut so the hearing is not covered. The guild issues them and takes them back.

items.name: A Wrecker's Lantern
items.description: Shows a light that is the wrong colour for a harbour and exactly the colour of one, at four miles, in rain.

items.name: A Pilot's Glass
items.description: Ground at Vashta Qal, mounted at Saltcliff, and worth more than the boat it is usually in.

items.name: A Greenway Charm
items.description: Laid thorn, three turns, grown rather than tied. Elderhollow makes them for people going into the Witchwood and does not explain them.

items.name: The Torc of the Ridge
items.description: Off the undug end of the Long Barrow, and whoever it was sized for was buried facing the other way from everybody else.

items.name: An Ilkhet Horn Bow
items.description: Sinew, horn and forty years' seasoning, and it will outshoot yew at twice the distance nobody on foot needs.

items.name: A Hold Hammer
items.description: Karn Dolur's pattern, made for a hand that expects to be swinging at stone and is not disappointed when it is not.

items.name: A Cinder Cloak
items.description: Woven from what the vent-readers pull out of the ash fall, which they will tell you is a kind of rock and is not.

items.name: Bell-Bronze
items.description: Cast from what came up with the old church, and it still has the note in it. Things that have been under water a long time do not care for the note.

items.name: Hold Plate
items.description: Karn Dolur's own, off the muster floor, and the ledger number is struck into the inside of the shoulder where it will outlast you.

items.name: A Sporeward Mask
items.description: Charcoal, wet linen and a picker's patience. The Rot goes through everything eventually and it goes through this last.

items.name: The Fulgurite Lens
items.description: Crater glass, ground at the Glass Quarter over nine years by a man who would not say what he was grinding it for.

items.name: The Rimeward Coat
items.description: The Ice Moot cuts them from what the glacier gives back, and will not sell one to anybody who has not set a cairn.

items.name: The Drowned Blade
items.description: Off the battery floor, green to the hilt, and silver under the green because the fort's armoury knew what the passage held.

items.name: The Maker's Tally
items.description: A bone stick notched on both edges: one side the nights the ice made, the other the nights it sounded. The two edges agree.

items.name: The Carver's Count
items.description: Eleven years of skulls, in a hand that got smaller each year as the columns got wider.

items.name: The Cutter's Stone
items.description: A palm of worked granite with a slot down it. Sighted through, the marker on the Glass Ice stops being a bearing across and becomes a bearing down.

items.name: A Shard of the Blue Bell
items.description: Cold that does not warm in the hand, and it will not stop ringing if you set it down.

items.name: The Rime-Singer's Torc
items.description: Bronze gone green under nine hundred years of ice. Worn, the note under the calving face resolves into something with edges — and so does every other thing that has been trying not to be heard.

items.name: The Strand-Warden's Coat
items.description: Sealskin with the fur turned in and a lining of something else. Whatever cut the skulls on the Strand cut this too, once, and did not get through.

items.name: The Lamp from the Moulin
items.description: It was lit when they shut the door on it, and it was still lit when the door came open. Nobody has been able to put it out.

items.name: The Weigher's Jar
items.description: A stoppered jar of the ninth course. Heavier than salt has any business being, and it does not taste of this sea.

items.name: The Cistern Keeper's Key
items.description: For a channel that runs out of a cistern nothing runs into. The office of keeper outlived the water by three hundred years.

items.name: The Lens They Do Not Sell
items.description: Ground every year by the Cutters' Hall since before the guild kept minutes. Looked through, the glass on the crater lip is not glass.

items.name: The Dune-Walker's Chart
items.description: Where the dunes were, year by year, in four hands over ninety years. One line on it goes a mile in a season.

items.name: A Measure of the Ninth
items.description: It draws water out of the air in a place that has none.

items.name: The Weigher's Scale
items.description: Brass, and older than the pans. What is set on it reads its true weight, which is not always the weight it has.

items.name: The Cistern Keeper's Ring
items.description: Three hundred years of an office with nothing to do. The stone in it is always cold and always slightly wet.

items.name: The Ground Lens, Mounted
items.description: The one the cutters make and do not sell, in a frame somebody made for it a very long time after. Worn, the lines in the glass have ends.

items.name: Iron off a Barred Door
items.description: The bar off a door in the uncovered town, straightened and hafted. It was on the outside, and whoever put it there meant it.

items.name: The Reader's Rhythm
items.description: Forty years of the tube's breathing, marked in soot on wood. It keeps no season, which is the entire point of it.

items.name: The Ashfall Deed
items.description: Title to a village nine feet under, held by a family that has farmed the ash over it for six generations and never once dug.

items.name: The Burner's Core
items.description: A hand-span of trunk from the new treeline, bored out. Forty rings in eleven years of wood, running the wrong way.

items.name: The Cutter's Rule
items.description: A brass rule the shelf-cutters use to find the true edge of the sheet. Laid on the glass it will not lie flat, and the way it lifts is a map.

items.name: Slag from the Turn
items.description: It was still moving when it cooled, and it cooled going upward.

items.name: The Kettle Ring
items.description: Iron off the tube's dressed stone, which the lava went around. It has been warm continuously for as long as anybody has held it.

items.name: The Hood off the Ashfall
items.description: Taken off a body that was not in a house. Nine feet of ash in one night and this came through it.

items.name: Haft of the Wrong Rings
items.description: Cut from the new treeline. Forty rings in eleven years, and it takes an edge no wood of that age should hold.

items.name: A Pane out of the Sheet
items.description: A sheet of the glass, worn across the shoulders, still faintly warm. The writing under it reads through from either side.

items.name: The Reed-Cutter's Bill
items.description: A hooked blade on a long haft, the only tool in the marsh that will take a cypress knee off level. Its edge is older than its handle by a century.

items.name: The Toll Ledger
items.description: Two hundred years of a shilling a head, balanced every year, in one hand with a broken g.

items.name: The Hermit's Tally
items.description: The door post itself, cut out and carried off: ninety years of fives, and the last ones not weathered.

items.name: The Heart of a Knee
items.description: Cut level and healed over forty years ago by something with a very good edge and no hands anybody would recognise.

items.name: The Marshlight Belt
items.description: Woven reed with something bright worked through it. In the maze it shows which rows are rows.

items.name: The Shilling Ring
items.description: Two hundred years of tolls, one shilling at a time, fused into a band. Worn, people ask you for less.

items.name: The Hermit's Watching Cloak
items.description: Oiled reed and something under it. Ninety years of sitting still facing the wrong way, and it has kept out every one of them.

items.name: The Pilot's Book
items.description: Two hundred springs of the Narrows redrawn, and one bearing that has never been rubbed out.

items.name: The Bird-Taker's Count
items.description: Eggs off the Bank by the season, back four generations. There is a year in it where the cut's column stops.

items.name: The Plate off the Capstan
items.description: Brass off the salvors' capstan with a line cut into it by somebody who came up and did not want to say it out loud.

items.name: A Pin off a Dogged Hatch
items.description: Driven from the outside, and bent by whatever was on the inside.

items.name: The Pilot's Ring
items.description: Two hundred years of a bearing that should have moved, cast into a band. Worn, a road you have walked once does not go wrong.

items.name: The Cloak of Forty Thousand
items.description: Tern feather over oiled canvas, out of a cut where no tern will nest. Nothing calls when you are wearing it.

items.name: The Gun That Was Run Out
items.description: A ship's swivel cut down to a haft. It came up loaded and it is still loaded, and nobody has been able to draw it.

items.name: The Posting House Book
items.description: Eleven years of southbound carts at night, none of them licensed, all of them written down by somebody who was paid not to notice and noticed anyway.

items.name: The Missing Drain Sheet
items.description: One sheet out of four hundred years of Aurenhal's drains, in a copyist's hand rather than the Library's, because the original went and somebody copied it first.

items.name: The Sluice Key
items.description: For a gate the parish stopped paying anybody to work ninety years ago, and which is worked to the day.

items.name: A Piece off the Second Face
items.description: Finer than roadstone, and there is none of it in any road.

items.name: The Road Mason's Belt
items.description: Tool-worn leather off somebody who worked both faces and was paid for one. It carries more than it looks like it should.

items.name: The Hood off the Third Turn
items.description: Oiled canvas, sooted through, out of a passage that has been bricked since before the King's Gate.

items.name: The Ring in the Ford Stone
items.description: Iron worn thin by a rope nobody has tied in living memory. Cold water does not trouble the wearer.

items.name: The Wayfinders' Rule
items.description: Four hundred years of the Deeproads measured and set down, including the two pages the guild reads aloud to nobody.

items.name: The Old Toll's Tally
items.description: What was taken on the market road, by whom, and in what — and the three years the column is in a different ink.

items.name: The Survey Plate
items.description: Brass, scribed with the vault's section. The shaft on it runs off the top of the plate and somebody has written a number beside it and then scratched it out.

items.name: Glass out of a Lamp
items.description: It has been burning without oil for four hundred years and it is cold to the touch.

items.name: The Lampwright's Lens
items.description: Ground from the glass of a lamp that needs no oil. Worn, the marks between the lamps are legible, and so is a great deal else.

items.name: The Footing Maul
items.description: Off the older stonework under the span. It is heavier than it is and it rings on nothing.

items.name: The Ninth Column's Coat
items.description: Salt-stiffened, off a body at the foot of the column that should not be there. It is still warm.

items.name: The Scouring Tally
items.description: A hazel rod notched once a year by whoever leads the clearing, and it has more notches on it than the parish has records.

items.name: The Harbour Master's Night Book
items.description: Two hundred years of bearings off a headland, in fourteen hands, and the correction is the same in all fourteen.

items.name: The Bailiff's Book
items.description: One entry a year since the town was a crossroads. The October line is always the same eleven words.

items.name: A Stone With a Corner On It
items.description: Cut chalk out of a hill that has no cut chalk in it, square to within a finger's width over four feet.

items.name: The Scourers' Belt
items.description: Hazel-bark cord and a buckle worn thin by three parishes' worth of hands. On open ground the wearer knows what is turf and what is only growing over.

items.name: The Hood off the Signal Course
items.description: Tarred canvas out of a tower with no stair in it. Light behaves oddly at the edge of it, and always has.

items.name: The Ring Nobody Came For
items.description: Off the October entry, the one year somebody looked. Worn, people find it hard to leave a question of yours unanswered.

items.name: The Wayhouse Mile Book
items.description: Every stage, every fare and every mark on the road, kept by four generations of the same family, all of whom counted fourteen.

items.name: The Burners' Charter
items.description: The right to cut, in writing, with the line they may not cut inside drawn on the back of it in a hand nobody at Rooksrest writes.

items.name: The Woodward's Rod
items.description: A perambulation rod, sixteen and a half feet, worn smooth at both ends by four hundred years of somebody's hands.

items.name: A Cutting Off the Same Tree
items.description: Live wood out of a mile-oak, and the leaf on it matches thirteen others and no tree anybody can find.

items.name: The Ring of the Fourteenth Mile
items.description: Oak and iron off a mark that is not on the road. Distances stop surprising the wearer.

items.name: The Cloak off the Green Bridge
items.description: Kept sound for two hundred years over a stream that is not there. Whatever crosses at night does not notice the wearer.

items.name: The Woodward's Belt
items.description: Sixteen and a half feet of rod hangs off it, and the wearer walks a line they have walked once as though they had walked it always.

items.name: The Hayward's Count
items.description: Forty years of counting the same eleven miles, in one hand, and the column does not settle.

items.name: The Relay Flood Book
items.description: Nine hundred years of the same week, kept by riders who each wrote down the day the grass told them and never why.

items.name: The Warrant for the Shoring
items.description: A timber order, signed and sealed, for a working on ground that has never been worked, dated in a year nobody uses any more.

items.name: A Stone Out of the Face
items.description: Dressed on five sides, laid level, and pulled out of a river bank forty feet below the grass.

items.name: The Belt of the Eleven Miles
items.description: Bark cord off a tree that was set in a season nobody wrote down. The wearer counts what is in front of them and gets it right.

items.name: The Ring of the Fourth Week
items.description: Iron off a ford post nine hundred years of riders have tied to. Water is slower to take the wearer than it should be.

items.name: The Hood off the Warm Water
items.description: Felt gone stiff with iron out of a spring that has never failed. Heat and thirst arrive later for whoever wears it.

items.name: The Sweeper's Tally
items.description: Four generations of somebody writing down that the steps were already clean, and the count they made each time.

items.name: The Snowgate Watch Book
items.description: Every night the road was shut, every night the bell was rung, and eleven nights on which those are not the same list.

items.name: The Survey That Stops
items.description: Karn Dolur's own mapping of the Cold Shoulder, to the inch, ending at a mouth with clean margin after it.

items.name: A Tread Off the Older Stair
items.description: Cut shorter and deeper than any step on the hold's stair, worn in the middle by something that did not walk the way we walk.

items.name: The Sweeper's Belt
items.description: Off somebody who climbed nine hundred and one steps a day for a wage nobody paid. Height stops mattering to the wearer's legs.

items.name: The Ring in the Bell Rope
items.description: Iron off the inside of the turn, worn by something that pulled from underneath. What the wearer signals is heard further than it should be.

items.name: The Hood off the Breathing Face
items.description: Felt and hide out of a mouth that blows warm onto ice that will not form. Cold arrives at the wearer late and leaves early.

items.name: The Hearth Rota
items.description: A hundred and sixty years of whose turn it was, unbroken, with two nights a year ruled through and nobody's name against them.

items.name: The Cutters' Book
items.description: Forty-one out and forty-one back, in four clerks' hands, with two lines that describe a difference and do not remark on it.

items.name: The Old Estate Map
items.description: Drives, butts and beaters' lines over the whole moor, and one line that goes over the scarp and keeps going.

items.name: Ash That Burned Green
items.description: Raked cold out of a fire that has been alight for two hundred years, off one of the two nights a year it changes colour.

items.name: The Ring off the Long Fire
items.description: Iron out of a hearth nobody has let go out. What the wearer lights is hard to put out, and so is the wearer.

items.name: The Belt Out of the Black Band
items.description: Tanned by eleven thousand years of peat into something that is not leather any more. It does not rot and neither, for a while, does what it is buckled around.

items.name: The Beater's Cloak
items.description: Off the eighth place in the line, the one that stands where the ground stops. Whatever is driven, it does not come at the wearer first.

items.name: The Warrant of the First Three
items.description: Hesper's own list, with the first three lines struck through and countersigned, which is a thing the Keepers have not had cause to do in nine hundred years.

items.name: The Cloak of the Eighth List
items.description: Keeper's oilcloth with eight lines stitched inside the collar and three of them picked out again in red.

items.name: The Belt Out of the Ward Cellars
items.description: Strapping off something that had been holding a door shut from the wrong side for a very long time.

items.name: The Ring Under the Keep
items.description: Found on the sixth finger of a hand that had five.

items.name: The Warrant of the Middle Three
items.description: Six lines struck through now. Hesper has stopped countersigning and started writing the date beside each one, which is what the order does when it expects to be read a long time from now.

items.name: The Helm Out of the Cut
items.description: Quarry iron beaten over something that was already the right shape, by a mason who never said what for.

items.name: The Ring of the Sunken Hall
items.description: Off a hand still resting on the arm of a chair, in a hall that was a hall before the water was water.

items.name: The Belt off the Milepost
items.description: A surveyor's belt with four hundred feet of vault under the stone it was left leaning against.

items.name: The List, Struck Out
items.description: Eight lines and a ninth written underneath in a different hand, and all nine of them struck through. Hesper has signed the bottom of it and then written the date twice, which she says is an order convention and is not.

items.name: The Hood off the Listening Room
items.description: Taken off the wall of a room built to hear a corridor four miles long. It hears rather more than that.

items.name: The Belt out of the Signal Deep
items.description: Six hundred years of vent-readers signalling past this and never to it, and it has been wearing this the whole time.

items.name: The Counter's Ring
items.description: Nine doors in eleven hundred years is not weather. This was on the hand that kept the tally, and the tally goes to more than nine.

What Was Bricked Up With Him

requires.description: somebody who would know what it is

monsters.name: Barrow Rat
monsters.description: Too large, too bold, and it came from under the mound.

monsters.name: Grave Hound
monsters.description: It was a dog. The barrow has had it for some while.

monsters.name: The Door-Warden
monsters.description: It was set to keep the barrow shut and it is still, in its way, doing that.

monsters.name: Weir Lamprey
monsters.description: Two feet of it, and a mouth that is all of it.

monsters.name: The Delver
monsters.description: Whatever cut the far end of the setts has been at it a long while, and has stopped needing to come up.

monsters.name: An Unliveried Digger
monsters.description: Working the under without a charter, for wages somebody in a much cleaner coat is paying.

monsters.name: The Gaoler
monsters.description: The old gaol was bricked up with its register still on the desk and somebody still on the book.

monsters.name: A Wrecker
monsters.description: Lime under the fingernails and a lantern they only light in certain weather.

monsters.name: A Drowned Hand
monsters.description: Came off the reef with the rest of the cargo and did not stop at the tide line.

monsters.name: The Light on the Point
monsters.description: Something has been showing a light off Gannet Head for ninety years, and the lighthouse is not it.

monsters.name: Thorn-Thing
monsters.description: The Thornward grew it, or grew around it. Elderhollow will not be drawn.

monsters.name: Hollow Walker
monsters.description: Under the Ring, and it has been walking the same circuit for a very long time.

monsters.name: A Sister's Shade
monsters.description: One of the nine. It is not pleased about the tenth.

monsters.name: Slag Crawler
monsters.description: Cooled enough to move and not enough to touch.

monsters.name: A Kurgan Rider
monsters.description: Buried with the horse, and neither of them has settled.

monsters.name: A Glass Thing
monsters.description: The crater made it, or something in the crater did.

monsters.name: The Hollow Beech
monsters.description: Four hundred years growing round a hole somebody dug, and it has taken the shape of what it grew around.

monsters.name: The East End
monsters.description: The Long Barrow has two ends and only one of them was ever dug. This is the other one's opinion about that.

monsters.name: The Dry River
monsters.description: The river went somewhere else in somebody's great-grandfather's time and something stayed in the bed waiting for it.

monsters.name: What Is In the Sink
monsters.description: The Weirwater goes into the ground at the swallet and comes out eleven miles away. Something in between has never needed to leave.

monsters.name: The Thing In the Throat
monsters.description: Nine hundred years of the vent going quietly, and the reason it went quietly.

monsters.name: Leech Swarm
monsters.description: The warm channels breed them and the marsh has never once objected.

monsters.name: A Bog Walker
monsters.description: The marsh keeps what it takes and occasionally gives some of it back on its feet.

monsters.name: What Rings the Bell
monsters.description: The old church went under in one night and the bell has been heard since, which is a thing the new tower will not discuss.

monsters.name: Fungal Horror
monsters.description: The Rot, walking, and it is mostly what it has eaten.

monsters.name: Rime Shade
monsters.description: It came up the Broken Stair from somewhere colder than the Frostmere.

monsters.name: What Is In the Old Seams
monsters.description: Karn Dolur stopped working the old seams in the year four hundred and has never written down which year it stopped for.

monsters.name: The Rot
monsters.description: Mycelt grows what the Deeproads eat. This grows Mycelt, and has been patient about the order of those two facts.

monsters.name: The Ninth Well
monsters.description: Eight wells were sunk for water. The ninth was sunk for something else and the diggers' camp does not go near it.

monsters.name: What the Last Cairn Held
monsters.description: The Ice Moot has kept eleven hundred cairns for nine hundred years and this is the one they count from.

monsters.name: The Battery
monsters.description: The drowned fort's guns are still pointed at the passage and something down there is still minding them.

monsters.name: A Rime Wight
monsters.description: The ice gives them back in the order it took them, which is not the order anybody would choose.

monsters.name: The Keeper of the Ninth
monsters.description: It has been on the other side of the ninth door for as long as there has been a ninth door.

monsters.name: Saeun, who Reads the Making
monsters.description: Forty years of sitting still in the cold, which is its own kind of hardiness.

monsters.name: Thrand, Bone Carver
monsters.description: Cuts bone all day and has the shoulders for it.

monsters.name: Hallr of the Rimewatch
monsters.description: Keeps a hut on a calving face alone, which selects for a particular sort of person.

monsters.name: The Blue Bell
monsters.description: It is not shaped like anything. It has been sounding one note since before the Landing was moved, and the note is what is wrong with the water.

monsters.name: The Cutter
monsters.description: Whatever went through those skulls in one stroke, and it has not put the edge down since.

monsters.name: What the Seal Was Written For
monsters.description: The stonework at the lip faces inward. Nine hundred years of somebody being extremely clear about which side of it they meant to be on.

monsters.name: Something Under the Pavement
monsters.description: The Flats are flagged for two miles and nobody laid them.

monsters.name: What Was Set Under the First
monsters.description: The moot counts from the Last Cairn and buries under the first, and does not discuss the difference.

monsters.name: Qasim, of the Weighing House
monsters.description: A lifetime of lifting counterweights, which is more lifting than it sounds.

monsters.name: Havva, Keeper of the Cistern
monsters.description: Three hundred years of an office and every one of them spent on ladders.

monsters.name: Naim, at the Cutters' Hall
monsters.description: Hands steady enough to grind a lens nobody is allowed to buy.

monsters.name: Sela, who Walks the Dunes
monsters.description: Ninety years of chart and the legs that made the last thirty of it.

monsters.name: What Draws the Ninth
monsters.description: It has been putting a ninth course into those pans every year for two hundred years, and nobody has ever asked what it wants the eight for.

monsters.name: What Has Been Drinking
monsters.description: A channel out of a cistern with nothing running into it is not a drain. It is a throat.

monsters.name: What Has the Fire Under It
monsters.description: Masonry under poured glass, and something below the masonry that the glass was poured to keep in. The city has been drinking the runoff for two hundred years.

monsters.name: What the Bars Were For
monsters.description: Every door barred from the street, before the sand. They did not get it out; they got everything else out.

monsters.name: The Root
monsters.description: Fulgurite goes down as far as the strike went, and this one went a long way down.

monsters.name: Esk, who Walks the Tube
monsters.description: Forty years of crawling up a hot tube builds a particular sort of person.

monsters.name: Borsa of the Ash Farm
monsters.description: Farms ash, which is heavier work than farming soil.

monsters.name: Tenn, Charcoal Burner
monsters.description: Stacks and tends a burn for nine days at a stretch.

monsters.name: Ovid, Shelf-Cutter
monsters.description: Works a material that opens a hand if you look away from it.

monsters.name: What Breathes in the Tube
monsters.description: It has kept the same rhythm for longer than the village, and the village has never once been cold.

monsters.name: What Stayed
monsters.description: Two houses dug and no bodies in either. Somebody stayed, and it was not a body that did it.

monsters.name: What Has Been Counting
monsters.description: Forty rings in eleven years is not fast growth. It is a count of something else kept in wood.

monsters.name: What Held the Heat
monsters.description: Nine hundred years under a mile of poured glass, and still too hot to put a hand flat on the treads above it.

monsters.name: The Thing in the Slag Cathedral
monsters.description: Cinderhold built a temple over a vent and the vent has opinions.

monsters.name: Maud, Reed-Cutter
monsters.description: Swings a hooked bill all day in water to the thigh.

monsters.name: Sarl of the Causeway
monsters.description: Poles a loaded punt against a tide twice a day.

monsters.name: Pell, who Wades
monsters.description: Goes where punts cannot, which selects for a certain nerve.

monsters.name: What Cuts Them Level
monsters.description: Forty years for a cypress knee to heal over a level cut. There are a hundred of them and they are in rows.

monsters.name: The Collector
monsters.description: Two hundred years of a balanced ledger. Somebody has been very conscientious about a road the Crown abandoned.

monsters.name: What Was Watched
monsters.description: Ninety years of somebody sitting in a doorway cutting a mark for each year they went on looking at it.

monsters.name: Hesk, Pilot of the Narrows
monsters.description: Forty years of standing on a heeling deck reading water.

monsters.name: Nella, Bird-Taker
monsters.description: Goes down a cliff on a rope for a living.

monsters.name: Bren of the Reef Camp
monsters.description: Dives a hundred feet on one breath, repeatedly, by choice.

monsters.name: What Holds Her
monsters.description: Two hundred years of one bearing in a channel that redraws every spring. Something down there has been very patient.

monsters.name: What the Birds Left
monsters.description: Forty thousand pairs will nest on a gun or a corpse. They will not nest here, and they have been right about it for a lifetime.

monsters.name: What They Shut In
monsters.description: Her guns were run out at the island and her hatches were dogged from the deck. The crew made both of those decisions.

monsters.name: Wend, at the Posting House
monsters.description: Handles horses that do not want handling, all day.

monsters.name: Marn, a Copyist
monsters.description: Sits still for a living and is not built for anything else.

monsters.name: Alsey, at the Ford
monsters.description: Farms two banks of a river, which is twice the walking.

monsters.name: What the Fine Stone Was Cut For
monsters.description: Eleven years of the best stone in the Kingsvale going south at night, and something at the bottom of the hole it came out of.

monsters.name: What Keeps the Third Turn Warm
monsters.description: Warm air off a bricked passage under a city, all year, since before the King's Gate.

monsters.name: The Keeper
monsters.description: Ninety years of a sluice worked to the day, by somebody the parish stopped paying and who did not stop.

monsters.name: Ost of the Wayfinders
monsters.description: Forty years of walking the Deeproads under load.

monsters.name: Bruk, at the Old Toll
monsters.description: Sits at a post nobody pays at, and has for thirty years.

monsters.name: Ilde, Surveyor
monsters.description: Carries a plate, a rule and a light into places nobody has measured.

monsters.name: What Hums in the Footings
monsters.description: A bridge over nothing, standing on footings, and the hum comes up through the stone rather than down off the span.

monsters.name: What Weeps
monsters.description: Eight columns hold the roof. This one has been holding something else, and it is warm, and it is salt.

monsters.name: What Lifted the Course Out
monsters.description: A course of treads taken out of the middle of a stair, cleanly, from below. Nine landings, and the ninth is where it stopped.

monsters.name: What Goes Downstream
monsters.description: The Sunless River goes somewhere and nobody has followed it there.

monsters.name: What Is in the Lower Workings
monsters.description: Lantern Deep dug down and stopped, and did not say why.

monsters.name: Ansel, on the Downs
monsters.description: Walks the chalk from dark to dark and has never once been hurried.

monsters.name: Veir, Harbour Master
monsters.description: Has talked forty tons of moving hull into the right berth without touching it.

monsters.name: Hask, Bailiff of Cobbleway
monsters.description: Takes hold of other people's livestock for a living, which selects for a grip.

monsters.name: What Cut Them Square
monsters.description: Four feet of cut chalk square to a finger's width, on a hill with no cut chalk in it, kept clear by three parishes who think they are keeping a horse.

monsters.name: What Keeps the Correction True
monsters.description: Four sightings in living memory, always the same week, in a tower with no stair — and two points to starboard is still the right correction.

monsters.name: The October Entry
monsters.description: Two hundred lines in a bailiff's book, all of them the same eleven words, and the fee paid in coin every year by somebody who has never once been seen at the yard.

monsters.name: Pyle, at the Wayhouse
monsters.description: Turns horses, hauls trunks and settles arguments, all day, every day.

monsters.name: Moll of the Burn
monsters.description: Tends a burn for four days without sleeping when it is at the wrong stage, which most years it is.

monsters.name: Kest, who Keeps the Hut
monsters.description: Lives four days' walk from the nearest field and has not needed anybody in all that time.

monsters.name: What Walks the Extra Three
monsters.description: Three marks that are not on the road, sighting along each other, and a lane worn six feet deep by something that has been keeping to it.

monsters.name: What Goes Up It At Night
monsters.description: Forty yards wide, nine miles straight, kept clear by something that has never once been seen doing it, and the deer will not cross.

monsters.name: Whoever Has Been Earning the Fee
monsters.description: Four hundred years of a quarterly payment to a post nobody has filled, and every mark on the edge of the wood re-cut on the same face, recently.

monsters.name: Serel, Hayward
monsters.description: Walks a parish boundary a week and argues about it for the other six days.

monsters.name: Talith of the Relay
monsters.description: Sixty miles between remounts, in a day, routinely.

monsters.name: Ondir, at the Last Water
monsters.description: Stands between everybody's thirst and the only water for two days in any direction.

monsters.name: What the Line Was Set Around
monsters.description: Eleven miles of one species in one season, running the wrong way for the wind, and a count that comes out different depending which end you start from.

monsters.name: What the Course Carried
monsters.description: Level courses of dressed stone going into a river bank in both directions, forty feet under nine hundred years of grass, and the river only borrows them four weeks a year.

monsters.name: What Keeps It Warm
monsters.description: Nine hundred years of a spring that has never failed, running warm and tasting of iron two miles from a country where nothing runs at all.

monsters.name: Bel, on the Steps
monsters.description: Climbs nine hundred and one steps a day and has since she could carry the broom.

monsters.name: Orn, on Watch
monsters.description: Stays awake for two nights when the sky looks wrong, which it does often here.

monsters.name: Vesk of the Ice Road
monsters.description: Has brought parties off the shoulder in weather that took the parties behind them.

monsters.name: Whoever Sweeps Them
monsters.description: Nine hundred steps swept every day of the year on a payroll that has no line for it, and a nine hundred and first that is swept as carefully as the rest.

monsters.name: What Pulls From Underneath
monsters.description: Eleven nights of a bell rung for a road that was open, and a rope worn on the face a standing hand cannot reach.

monsters.name: What Does the Breathing
monsters.description: In and out to the minute, in a gale or a calm, warm, out of a face that has been in shade since anybody began writing things down.

monsters.name: Wenna, whose Turn It Is
monsters.description: Has carried peat across open moor in weather that stopped the mail, on a rota, without comment.

monsters.name: Hald, who Cuts
monsters.description: Swings a turf spade all day in ground that does not want to let go of it.

monsters.name: Ferrin, at the Bothy
monsters.description: Lives eleven miles from the nearest roof that is not his and prefers it.

monsters.name: What the Fire Feeds
monsters.description: Two hundred years alight on a third of the peat it burns, and two nights a year when it goes green and a village is indoors before dark without anybody saying so.

monsters.name: What Puts Them Back
monsters.description: Forty-one out of the deep peat and forty-one written down as returned, in four clerks' hands, two of the lines noting a difference and none of them remarking on it.

monsters.name: What the Drive Drives
monsters.description: Eight worn places in front of a roofless house, evenly spaced, and a line on the map that goes over the scarp and keeps going down.

monsters.name: What Came Through the First
monsters.description: A cellar bar chewed through and put back up from the inside, every year, for as long as there has been a ward-house over it.

monsters.name: What Came Through the Second
monsters.description: Four hundred years of a moor taking a keep back, and an undercroft under it that has stayed dry.

monsters.name: What Came Through the Third
monsters.description: A root cellar with a floor under the floor, and the third line on a Keeper's list struck through in red by somebody who was not the Keeper.

monsters.name: A Door-Walker
monsters.description: Eight doors were opened and only the ninth was watched. These are what has been walking between them since.

monsters.name: What Came Through the Fourth
monsters.description: Eight hundred feet of gallery cut along a seam that does not exist, to a face nobody ever put a pick into.

monsters.name: What Came Through the Fifth
monsters.description: A hall the marsh covered, still arranged, and one chair in it that has been occupied the whole time.

monsters.name: What Came Through the Sixth
monsters.description: Four hundred feet of dressed vault under a milepost on a road that measures nothing, and one way down into it.

monsters.name: A Keeper of the Middle
monsters.description: Stone was put over three doors carefully. Something has been checking on the stone.

monsters.name: What Came Through the Seventh
monsters.description: A room built to hear four miles of corridor, and something in it that has heard every footfall on that floor since there was a floor.

monsters.name: What Came Through the Eighth
monsters.description: Six hundred years of vent-readers signalling past a deep and never to it, and not one of them ever told why.

monsters.name: Whatever Kept the Count
monsters.description: Nine doors in eleven hundred years, opened in order, by somebody. The tally is cut into the underside of a ring of stones in a wood nobody goes into, and it does not stop at nine.

monsters.name: A Tally-Keeper
monsters.description: Somebody had to walk between nine doors over eleven hundred years and know which were still shut. These are what did the walking.

factions.name: The Crown
factions.description: Aurenhal, its wardens, and a very firm preference for nothing alarming being written down.

factions.name: The Grand Library
factions.description: Scholars who hold that a thing unrecorded is a thing lost, and who are not always careful about the cost.

factions.name: The Keepers
factions.description: Cairn-tenders, the Elderhollow moot, the wardens of the Sisters. Not an order and not a guild — a habit, kept in eleven places by people who have never met.

factions.name: The Hold of Karn Dolur
factions.description: Nine hundred years of not opening the Deep Door, and a ledger of every fee ever charged for the privilege of not being let through it.

factions.name: The Wayfinders
factions.description: Forty people at Lantern Deep who can get you from there to Karn Dolur and back, and the number is not going up.

factions.name: What Was Shut
factions.description: Whatever the wards were built against. It has a side, and the side is not yours.

factions.name: The Ratcatchers' Guild
factions.description: Forty-one people with a charter, a livery, and the only complete map of what is under Aurenhal. They did not make the map for the Crown and they are not showing it to the Crown.

factions.name: The Countinghouse
factions.description: Sarnport's exchange, its harbour court, and the insurers who between them decide what a drowned ship was worth and who has to say so out loud.

factions.name: The Salvors
factions.description: The Isles and the Strand, and a very old argument about the difference between a wreck and a cargo. They have never once lost it in front of a magistrate, because no magistrate has ever come.

factions.name: The Ilkhet Lines
factions.description: Nine families, eleven thousand horses, and a grazing right that is older than the Crown and has never been written down anywhere the Crown could read it.

factions.name: The Vent-Readers
factions.description: Cinderhold's oldest office: eleven people who watch what the ground is doing and are believed, because the two times they were not, there is a village under the ash.

factions.name: The Pole-Ferrymen
factions.description: Thornmere has no roads, one bell, and a hundred and six people who know which channels are where this week. Everything that crosses the marsh crosses because they said so.

factions.name: The Ice Moot
factions.description: Cairnhold's half of the Keepers' habit, kept eleven hundred miles from anybody who would call it that. They tend the northern cairns and have opinions about the southern ones.

factions.name: The Pickers
factions.description: Mycelt grows the food the Deeproads eat, and the Rot eats Mycelt. The pickers stand between those two facts with knives.

factions.name: The Water Wardens of Vashta Qal
factions.description: One spring, four thousand people, and an office that decides how much of it you are, personally, allowed to drink.

npcs.name: Hedda of the Ploughshare
npcs.description: Keeps the inn, the village's memory, and a ledger of who owes whom.

npcs.name: Under-Steward Vail
npcs.description: Runs the part of the Crown's business that does not get written down, and would like it to stay that way.

npcs.name: Orrin, Keyholder of the Fourth
npcs.description: Four floors of shelving in his charge and a locked door on the fourth that he has never once explained.

npcs.name: Hesk of the Moot
npcs.description: Elderhollow sends him where a ward needs looking at. He has been busy.

npcs.name: Ulla of Cairnhold
npcs.description: Eleven years' training to know which stone goes where, and she is a long way from her cairns.

npcs.name: Bel of the Thornward
npcs.description: Lays thorn, and has laid it in the same line for thirty-one years.

npcs.name: Maun of the Nine Sisters
npcs.description: Keeps the ring for Barrowgate, which mostly means keeping people off it, and has kept a rubbing of the tenth stone for nine years.

npcs.name: Tenkh of the Skull Line
npcs.description: Rides the line, counts the poles, and replaces the ones that go.

npcs.name: Sull of the Wayfinders
npcs.description: Forty people can get you from Lantern Deep to Karn Dolur and back. She is the one who will.

npcs.name: Dath, Speaker of the Gate
npcs.description: Nine hundred years of not opening the Deep Door, and he has the ledger to prove every one of them.

npcs.name: Nesh of the Eel Camp
npcs.description: Runs six huts, eleven traps and a season that ended two months ago. She has not gone home and will not say what she is waiting for.

npcs.name: Gadd, of the Bridge Fund
npcs.description: Collects for the Crown with one hand and for the bridge with the other, and is scrupulous about which hand.

npcs.name: Dree, Warden of the Under
npcs.description: Forty-one people under her and a charter older than the dynasty. Three of the forty-one are unaccounted for and she has stopped pretending otherwise.

npcs.name: Ilv, a Copyist
npcs.description: Keeps a room behind a pawnbroker's on Anchor Lane, which is a long way from the fourth gallery and is the point.

npcs.name: Orl, Wreckmaster
npcs.description: Decides who goes out to what, and takes the share nobody argues with. Has buried more sailors than he has salvaged, and mentions it when the Hall is listening.

npcs.name: Cass of the Kiln
npcs.description: Burnt chalk for sixty years until the kiln went cold, and has stayed on in the burner's hut because there is nowhere she would rather be cold.

npcs.name: Maun, Underwriter
npcs.description: Nine years of losses off one headland, written down in a hand that gets smaller as the column gets longer.

npcs.name: Bry, Keeper of the Light
npcs.description: A hundred and ten feet of stair, twice a night, and a logbook he has stopped showing to the Pilots' Hall.

npcs.name: Wend of the Beeches
npcs.description: Forty-one years in a hollow tree, on the understanding that he leaves the thorn alone and says if anything changes. It changed two years ago.

npcs.name: Pell, Fellow of the Library
npcs.description: A fellow's warrant, a purse, eleven diggers on day rates, and two letters from the Elderhollow moot that she has filed rather than answered.

npcs.name: Saray of the Wells
npcs.description: Keeps three wells, two of which have water, and has kept the third swept for nine years on the grounds that it might come back.

npcs.name: Hulf, Warden of the Pass
npcs.description: Keeps the Highpass ward on the Hold's behalf, holds the Hold's ledger of what the mountain's water has done since the year eleven, and has been told to sort this out without it becoming the Hold's problem.

npcs.name: Ilka of the Eleven
npcs.description: Youngest of the vent-readers by nineteen years, and the only one of them willing to say out loud what the chain is doing.

npcs.name: Gost of the Channels
npcs.description: Knows which channels are where this week, which is the whole profession. Has lost two poles and a cousin to the black water since Harvest and mentions the poles.

npcs.name: Vare of the Hall of Measures
npcs.description: Keeps the Hold's standards — the yard, the mark, the fee — and by extension every decision the Hold has ever declined to revisit.

npcs.name: Kesk of the Beds
npcs.description: Two hundred years of pickers before her held the line at the fifth gallery. She has been driven back to the second in one season and does the arithmetic out loud.

npcs.name: Sefa of the Spring
npcs.description: Measures out one spring between four thousand people, and has been posted to Bone Wells for asking, in writing, why the ninth shaft is on the survey and not on the roster.

npcs.name: Ottir, Stone-Setter
npcs.description: Knows which stone goes where across eleven hundred cairns and has not slept properly since the glacier gave one back.

npcs.name: Runa, Wreckmaster of Blackrigging
npcs.description: Has salvaged everything in these waters that can be got at, twice, and keeps a list of the four crews that went into the fort.

npcs.name: Saeun, who Reads the Making
npcs.description: Sits at the end of the Landing with a bone stick and marks it when the ice makes. Forty years of that. Nobody has ever asked her why.

npcs.name: Thrand, Bone Carver
npcs.description: Cuts scrimshaw for the ships and has been counting the Strand for eleven years in a book he does not show people.

npcs.name: Hallr of the Rimewatch
npcs.description: Keeps a hut, a log and a sighting stone at the calving face, and is extremely clear that he keeps them for the moot and not for you.

npcs.name: Gudny, at the Flensing Yard
npcs.description: Twenty-two seasons on the yard and the only one left who worked the old landing before they moved it.

npcs.name: Orma, at the Ice Chapel
npcs.description: Keeps a chapel nobody attends in a town that buries at sea, and has opinions about which way a thing is facing when it arrives.

npcs.name: Vigdis, at the Strand Camp
npcs.description: Works the boneyard for what the Landing will buy and sleeps out there, which nobody else in the Frostmere will do.

npcs.name: Ingimund, the Factor
npcs.description: Holds the Landing's ledgers back to the move and would very much rather discuss this season's oil price.

npcs.name: Qasim, of the Weighing House
npcs.description: Weighs every course out of the pans and has weighed one more each year than anybody cut, since he was an apprentice.

npcs.name: Havva, Keeper of the Cistern
npcs.description: Holds an office three hundred years older than the last water in it, and keeps the key oiled.

npcs.name: Naim, at the Cutters' Hall
npcs.description: Grinds one lens a year that the Hall does not sell, does not display, and does not have minutes for.

npcs.name: Sela, who Walks the Dunes
npcs.description: Has ninety years of where the sand was, in four hands, and only one line on it that she cannot explain.

npcs.name: Ilyas, at the White Chapel
npcs.description: Keeps the chapel at night because somebody has to, and has therefore been the only person awake for two hundred pan-seasons' worth of arrivals.

npcs.name: Dov, at the Green Room
npcs.description: Runs the cellar under the Green Room and has been down there long enough to know exactly which wall is warm.

npcs.name: Taj of the Wardens
npcs.description: Meters every well in Vashta Qal to the cup and is professionally unable to stop thinking about the one that is not metered.

npcs.name: Reyhan, Pan-Cutter
npcs.description: Cuts eight courses a year, as her mother did, and is very clear that eight is what the sun will draw.

npcs.name: Ferruh, Well-Digger
npcs.description: Digs dry holes for a living in a country that has nothing else to offer, and knows to the foot where the damp starts.

npcs.name: Esk, who Walks the Tube
npcs.description: Has been in and out of the lava tube for forty years and has forty years of its breathing marked in soot on a board.

npcs.name: Borsa of the Ash Farm
npcs.description: Six generations of farming the ash over a village her family holds the deed to, and not one of them has ever put a spade in it.

npcs.name: Tenn, Charcoal Burner
npcs.description: Burns the new treeline for charcoal and has been bothered by the rings in it for eleven years.

npcs.name: Ovid, Shelf-Cutter
npcs.description: Cuts obsidian off the sheet for the Reach's blades and owns the rule that finds its true edge, which will not lie flat on it.

npcs.name: Vaso, at the Kettle
npcs.description: Keeps the only inn on warm ground in the Reach and has never once had to light the fire for the floor.

npcs.name: Iman, who Walks the Drifts
npcs.description: Crosses the Ashfall for a living because the road round it is four days, and knows exactly which drifts are warm.

npcs.name: Maud, Reed-Cutter
npcs.description: Cuts and bundles for the thatchers, and owns the only bill in Thornmere whose edge is a hundred years older than its handle.

npcs.name: Sarl of the Causeway
npcs.description: Poles the crossing when the causeway is under, and keeps the ferrymen's book, which is where the toll ledger goes.

npcs.name: Pell, who Wades
npcs.description: Goes where the punts cannot and came back once with a door post nobody had asked for.

npcs.name: Orin, at the Bundle
npcs.description: Knows every cutter, thatcher and leech-man in the Bottom by name, which is why the one she cannot name bothers her.

npcs.name: Bel the Thatcher
npcs.description: Roofs half of Thornmere and has an opinion about every cut surface in the marsh, professionally.

npcs.name: Gost of the Leech Camp
npcs.description: Farms leeches for the temples and knows to the yard where they will not live.

npcs.name: Hesk, Pilot of the Narrows
npcs.description: Takes hulls through a channel that redraws itself every spring, and keeps the book that says how it redrew.

npcs.name: Nella, Bird-Taker
npcs.description: Takes eggs off Tern Bank in season, as her mother did, and keeps four generations of the count.

npcs.name: Bren of the Reef Camp
npcs.description: Dives the reef for the Salvors and came up off the deep wreck once with a line cut into a brass plate and nothing to say.

npcs.name: Othe, at the Gun Forge
npcs.description: Keeps Halfmast's guns for a fort with no garrison, and knows what iron of what age looks like.

npcs.name: Dree, at the Shag
npcs.description: Keeps the only roof on Cormorant that will take a stranger, and listens to the water for a living without meaning to.

npcs.name: Ilva, at the Rock Chapel
npcs.description: Buries what the sea gives back, which on Cormorant is a full-time occupation, and has views about which way things are pointing.

npcs.name: Wend, at the Posting House
npcs.description: Changes horses on the Kingsroad and writes down every cart that goes past, which the Crown has never asked her to do.

npcs.name: Marn, a Copyist
npcs.description: Copies the Library's drain sheets for the Craftrow guilds and once copied one the week before it went missing.

npcs.name: Alsey, at the Ford
npcs.description: Farms both banks at Pennyford and has watched the sluice go up in the spring and down at the harvest her whole life.

npcs.name: Hob, Road Mason
npcs.description: Lays and relays the Kingsroad and can tell you which quarry every stone in it came out of, which is why the second face bothers him.

npcs.name: Tass, of the Long Wharf
npcs.description: Works lighters up and down the Aurenhal reach and has been past that grate four times a day for twenty years.

npcs.name: Nib, at the Drowned Ox
npcs.description: Keeps an inn named after an animal that drowned in eleven inches of water and has heard every joke about it.

npcs.name: Ost of the Wayfinders
npcs.description: Keeps the guild's rule, which is four hundred years of the Deeproads measured, and two pages of it he has never read aloud.

npcs.name: Bruk, at the Old Toll
npcs.description: Sits at a toll post on a road the guild stopped tolling, because somebody has to, and keeps the tally because his father did.

npcs.name: Ilde, Surveyor
npcs.description: Scribes the guild's sections onto brass and once put a number beside a shaft and then scratched it out.

npcs.name: Hral, who Walks the Span
npcs.description: Crosses the Black Bridge twice a day with a load and has dropped more lights down that chasm than the guild has.

npcs.name: Vess, who Keeps the Lamps
npcs.description: Holds an office that has nothing to do, since the lamps have not needed anything for four hundred years, and walks the road anyway.

npcs.name: Ansel, on the Downs
npcs.description: Runs four hundred sheep over the white rock and leads the spring clearing because his mother did and hers did.

npcs.name: Veir, Harbour Master
npcs.description: Berths every hull that comes into Sarnport and keeps the night book her predecessors kept, without ever having been told why.

npcs.name: Hask, Bailiff of Cobbleway
npcs.description: Impounds strays, collects the fee, and writes one line every October that he did not put anything into.

npcs.name: Tibb, at Downs Farm
npcs.description: Farms the last field before the cliff and has looked up at that hillside every day of a long life.

npcs.name: Orsa, off the Haul
npcs.description: Eleven boats work off that beach and hers is the one the other ten watch to see when it is worth going.

npcs.name: Rell, Chandler
npcs.description: Sells rope, tar, lamp oil and charts, and has opinions about which of the charts are worth the paper.

npcs.name: Pyle, at the Wayhouse
npcs.description: Fourth of the family to keep the stage on the Moot Road, and the fourth to count fourteen miles on an eleven-mile road.

npcs.name: Moll of the Burn
npcs.description: Burns charcoal in a clearing the smoke never leaves, and holds the charter that says where she may not do it.

npcs.name: Kest, who Keeps the Hut
npcs.description: Lives in a woodward's hut, is not the woodward, and has stopped explaining the difference to people.

npcs.name: Dunn, who Carts
npcs.description: Runs the coast road and the forest road in the same week and has opinions about both, mostly about the state of them.

npcs.name: Ives, at the Charcoal Store
npcs.description: Weighs, bags and sells what comes out of the burns, and knows every burner's stretch of wood by the taste of the smoke.

npcs.name: Ferre, at the Wet Boot
npcs.description: Keeps the only bed at a crossroads everybody arrives at wet, and hears the whole of both roads twice a day.

npcs.name: Serel, Hayward
npcs.description: Counts what the village owns, including eleven miles of trees the village does not remember acquiring.

npcs.name: Talith of the Relay
npcs.description: Rides the long stage and keeps the book the riders have kept since there were riders.

npcs.name: Ondir, at the Last Water
npcs.description: Lives at the edge of where things grow and lets people drink, which is the whole of the job and takes all of it.

npcs.name: Bree, at the Crossing
npcs.description: Camps where nine hundred years of people have camped, at a crossing that has not needed crossing in any of them.

npcs.name: Kosh, in the Shade
npcs.description: Grazes four hundred head along eleven miles of trees and has walked the length of them more times than anybody alive.

npcs.name: Ana, at the Cut Store
npcs.description: Buys hay by the load and sells everything a rider forgot, which is most things.

npcs.name: Bel, on the Steps
npcs.description: Fourth of the family to sweep a stair that is always already clean, and the fourth to go on doing it anyway.

npcs.name: Orn, on Watch
npcs.description: Sits up for the nights the road might shut, and has written down eleven he cannot account for.

npcs.name: Vesk of the Ice Road
npcs.description: Takes people over the shoulder to the ice and back, and holds the hold's survey of it because somebody has to.

npcs.name: Dorn, at the Broken Road
npcs.description: Keeps a house on a road that has not been mended since the great rains and does perfectly well out of the fact.

npcs.name: Hesk, at the Gate Store
npcs.description: Sells rope, tallow, nails and boots to everybody going up and everybody coming down, and looks at both.

npcs.name: Ruvo, at the Forge
npcs.description: Works coal that comes up warm and has stopped mentioning it, which took some doing.

npcs.name: Wenna, whose Turn It Is
npcs.description: Holds the rota for a fire that has not gone out in two hundred years and has never once had to hurry.

npcs.name: Hald, who Cuts
npcs.description: Takes turf out of the only firm ground for two miles and has carried three of the forty-one up the duckboards himself.

npcs.name: Ferrin, at the Bothy
npcs.description: Lives in the only shelter in the Heatherlands and keeps the estate's old map because the estate stopped wanting it.

npcs.name: Ivy, at the Hearth Store
npcs.description: Sells the parish its peat by the load and has done the arithmetic more than once.

npcs.name: Sask, at the Beacon
npcs.description: Keeps the inn a fire was lit to guide people to, and hears every version of every story on this moor twice a night.

npcs.name: Bram, at the Cutters' Store
npcs.description: Weighs turf, keeps the book, and wrote two of the lines in it that he would rather he had not.

npcs.name: Hesper, of the Eighth List
npcs.description: Has spent a working life on the eight doors nobody cared about, and came down to Lantern Deep the week the ninth stopped being interesting.

traps.name: Snare
traps.description: A noose in a run, set by somebody who knew which run.

traps.name: Covered Pit
traps.description: Hurdles and turf over a hole somebody took real trouble digging.

traps.name: Dart Slab
traps.description: A floor slab on a pivot, and a row of holes in the wall opposite.

traps.name: Falling Block
traps.description: A ceiling stone held by a pin, and the pin is on a trip.

traps.name: Scything Blade
traps.description: Set in a slot cut across the passage, and the slot has been swept.

traps.name: Broken Seal
traps.description: A jar bedded in the floor with a thread across the passage above it.

traps.name: Flame Jet
traps.description: A nozzle low in the wall, sooted in a fan across the floor.

traps.name: False Floor
traps.description: Snow-bridge over a melt hole, and it has held so far.

traps.name: Collapsing Stair
traps.description: Three treads rotted through and dressed to look like the rest.

traps.name: Alarm Wire
traps.description: A wire at ankle height with something noisy on the far end of it.

terrains.name: Grass
terrains.description: Ordinary turf, cropped short by whatever grazes here.

terrains.name: Meadow
terrains.description: Long grass and flowering weeds, up to the knee.

terrains.name: Cropland
terrains.description: Planted rows. Walking through them is nobody's favourite.

terrains.name: Fallow Field
terrains.description: Turned earth resting a season.

terrains.name: Mossy Ground
terrains.description: Deep moss over old roots. Quiet underfoot.

terrains.name: Leaf Litter
terrains.description: Years of leaf-fall, and it announces every step.

terrains.name: Heather
terrains.description: Woody purple scrub that hides the ground it grows on.

terrains.name: Steppe Grass
terrains.description: Grass to the horizon, all of it leaning the same way.

terrains.name: Shingle
terrains.description: Wave-rolled stones that slide underfoot.

terrains.name: Salt Flat
terrains.description: White crust over old sea-bed. It crunches.

terrains.name: Dirt Road
terrains.description: Rutted track, and better than the field beside it.

terrains.name: The Kingsroad
terrains.description: Cut stone laid straight, kept up by the crown and its tolls.

terrains.name: Cobbles
terrains.description: Round stones set in sand. Cart-ruts worn into them.

terrains.name: Flagstones
terrains.description: Flat-cut paving, the mark of somewhere that had money.

terrains.name: Boardwalk
terrains.description: Planks over water or mud, with gaps to watch for.

terrains.name: Timber Floor
terrains.description: Swept boards.

terrains.name: Rug
terrains.description: Woven and much walked on.

terrains.name: Bridge
terrains.description: A crossing with rails, or without.

terrains.name: Jetty
terrains.description: Boards on piles, out over the water.

terrains.name: Stair
terrains.description: Cut steps, going up or down as the case may be.

terrains.name: Shallows
terrains.description: Ankle-deep and cold.

terrains.name: Deep Water
terrains.description: Over your head. You will have to swim it.

terrains.name: River
terrains.description: Moving water with an opinion about where you are going.

terrains.name: Marsh
terrains.description: Standing water and sucking mud in equal measure.

terrains.name: Reeds
terrains.description: Tall enough to hide a person, and often does.

terrains.name: Bog Pool
terrains.description: Black water of no honest depth.

terrains.name: Tree
terrains.description: Trunk enough to stop you and shade enough to hide what is behind it.

terrains.name: Thicket
terrains.description: Young growth packed tight. Slow, and blind.

terrains.name: Bramble
terrains.description: Thorns that take payment in cloth and skin.

terrains.name: Stump
terrains.description: Cut a long time ago by somebody who is not here.

terrains.name: Rock
terrains.description: Bare stone, gone vertical.

terrains.name: Scree
terrains.description: Loose slope that moves when you do.

terrains.name: Cliff
